Patient week steps for departure prep
You will learn on this page the order of work
This topic matters because careful preparation protects the passenger, the animal, and the airline's service standard. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, new staff must guide each case with calm, steady attention and clear language. Begin by reviewing the travel record, then confirm the pet details, crate arrangement, and any required support notes. If a customer arrives uncertain, explain the process in plain terms and keep the focus on what must be done next. The coordinator should give direct guidance before departure, and your role is to support that guidance with prompt follow-up and respectful communication.

When you handle a request, listen first and record only what is necessary. Check for missing items, remind the passenger of required preparation, and make sure any concerns are passed to the proper team without delay. Use a courteous tone even when the desk is busy, because the customer is often worried about the animal's comfort and acceptance for travel. If a case includes special handling, keep your notes tidy and your language precise. Never guess, and never leave a passenger without a next step.

The desk protects trust by being organized, responsive, and consistent. Remember to keep the customer informed, keep the record accurate, and keep the animal's welfare at the center of every action.
